narrative.title: The Emblem Prefix Forge
narrative.scenario: A security firm stamps access badges with codes that must read as palindromes, but legacy badges fail the check. The forging machine may only prepend characters — the existing code stays untouched at the end. The badge system computes the shortest prependable patch that turns each legacy code into a palindrome.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the shortest palindrome obtainable by adding characters only in front of s.
constraints: s consists of lowercase English letters

testCases.explanation: Prepending one 'a' completes the palindrome; the longest palindromic head of s spans "aacecaa".
The longest palindromic head is just "a", so the remaining "bcd" reversed goes in front.

hintLevels: Level 1: Only the longest palindromic head of s can stay put; everything after it must be mirrored in front.
Level 2: Run KMP on s + sep + reverse(s); the final LPS value is the longest palindromic head length.
Level 3: The separator must be a character absent from s, or the border can bleed across the join.
